verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents CLI flags or parameters for GPU layer offload or context length when loading a model. The only CLI evidence is generic commands ('ollama run --verbose', 'ollama pull', 'ollama launch'), and one community comment says Ollama hides server configuration behind its own defaults. The axis clearly applies to a local model runner, so the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load a model with custom GPU offload and context length settings from the command line
